Lead PM — Payments, London hybrid.

Ridgeline Pay is a payments fintech that recently closed a seed-extension round; runway beyond the next 18 months isn't yet locked in, so we're being disciplined about scope. We're hiring a Lead PM to own SMB lending operations end to end: underwriting queues, repayment scheduling, and portfolio risk tooling for small-business borrowers. Pricing sits inside your remit too — you'll partner with the pricing squad on rate-card experiments for the lending product, though SMB ops is the centre of the job. Hybrid: two days a week in our London office. We want someone who can run a lending-ops roadmap and isn't afraid of ambiguous, still-early-stage economics.
